arenas._comment_dressing: Roadside practice ground: open grass, dressing outside the 12x8 grid per the standing rule. Enemy spawns are Chebyshev 5 from the player spawn ON PURPOSE: 3 free steps exhaust the pool short of contact (beat 3), Dash covers the rest with AP to spare for one attack -- the full teaching arc fits in turn 1.

tutor_lines.line: Relc: Loose grip, dead stance. We'll fix both. Step where you're looking. Three easy steps a turn, so use your legs before anything fancy.
Relc: That's walking. Now get next to one and attack. That's your arm. Numbers are your moves, remember them.
Relc: Steps run out, see? Slot 2: [Dash]. Costs you wind, buys you stride.
Relc: And the legs are back. Wind for stride. That trade wins fights.
Relc: Pick your target, then commit. A spear only argues with one thing at a time.
Relc: Ha! Straw everywhere. When you're spent, call it. End your turn on YOUR terms.
Relc: Turn's done. Now stand there and watch what comes back at you. That's half of fighting.
Relc: Not bad for someone who smells of dish soap. Sleep is where a fight settles into your bones. Do that. Then come see me; I owe you something.

arenas._comment: Layout-identical clone of goblin_ambush carrying its own tutor beats (arenas own tutor_lines, and goblin_ambush is shared with goblin_encounter_2, which must stay beat-free). goblin_encounter_1 points here. TRAP: `road_clear`'s `line` carries TWO sentences appended into one entry, not two separate tutor_lines entries -- no shipped QA script pins its exact text (every reference is `payload_contains: {beat: "road_clear"}`), but `combat_hud.gd`'s `match_tutor_line` fires at most ONE tutor entry per incoming event (`ready[0]`), so a second entry on the SAME combat_finished/victory trigger could never fire; appending to the existing line is the only way to land a second beat here. The feed panel auto-grows for tutor lines (`_grow_feed_panel_for_tutor`, capped/evicts oldest -- see CLAUDE.md's wrapped-line-budget gotcha) and this fires as the LAST beat of the fight, so evicting older combat-log lines here is harmless.

tutor_lines.line: Relc: Real ones this time. Stay behind me if you have to. You slept, so check your numbers: 3 and up are your [Skills] now. Earned, not given.
Relc: That one puts everything behind one blow. What your slots hold follows the weapon you carry: sword skills for a sword arm, spear skills for mine.
Relc: THAT'S the stuff. Attacks keep you alive. [Skills] win the fight. Sleep grows both.
Relc: Road's clear. Liscor's through the gate. Tell the Watch that Relc let you pass. See the sign? Her inn, her rule. But under her roof? Don't.

arenas._comment: The deep warren -- the Awakened Raskghar's boss arena (12x8 per the M1 arena contract test_combat_data enforces; cave biome, darkest pin lives in data/moods.json arena_moods.deep_warren). Interior `blocked` cells are twin broken pillars (x3/x8) + a central rubble block (x6) that make the fight about POSITIONING: they break the boss's range-2 maul line-of-sight and give the player + Relc lanes to corner the kiting boss against, rather than an open trade. All six blocked cells are kept clear of every player/enemy spawn (test_combat_data asserts spawn reachability + connectivity). Balance band is gated in sim_combat_batch.gd's BOSS_CELLS.

arenas._comment: The witch's hollow -- shared arena for both `briar_collectors` and `briar_collectors_deep` (same clearing, escalated roster on the second wave). Blocked cells are the bent-tree ring (a forest clearing, not a walled room) -- kept off every spawn column/row so the reachability BFS in test_combat_data.gd holds; they render as hollow_bent_tree/bush_green props via board_renderer.gd's BLOCKED_PROPS_BY_BIOME (single-cell-scale picks only -- see hollow_bent_tree's own sprites.json constraint). floor_layers uses ONLY the biome's two already-verified Fairy Forest coords ([2,2] flat underwood + [9,9] textured grass -- data/biomes.json witch_hollow's own picks, no new guesses); decor sits OUTSIDE the 12x8 grid (the goblin_ambush/cave_mouth rule) in the map's own bent-tree register: canopy trees looming on both flanks, small trees behind the top edge. Windowed-verified via riverfarm_fight's 01 screenshot.

floor_layers._pick: Understory variation reusing the witch_hollow biome's OWN two verified Tiles.png coords -- [2,2] flat underwood green (the biome floor) repeated so [9,9] textured grass lands on roughly every third cell.

arenas._comment: Village edge at night -- `river_wolf_pack`'s arena, reached only through the map's own night-phase encounter gate (unreachable at day by design; the day-negative canonical proof is lane alpha's). biome `riverfarm_village` reuses the village's own staged floor family (docs/design/riverfarm-art/handoff.md) rather than a bespoke night biome -- the dark read comes from atmosphere.gd's phase mood grade, not a different tileset. Sparse blocked cells (an open field, not a forest) -- an ambush wants sightlines, not cover. TRAP for whoever wires moods.json: confirm riverfarm_village's night grade against atmosphere.gd's arena-brightness floor (the cave_mouth precedent) before shipping -- a fight this dark could read as HP-bar-illegible even though nothing here structurally requires an `arena_moods` override. floor_layers/decor empty for the same not-yet-verified-biome reason as witch_hollow.
